:::{#sol-augmented-vector-practice}

Let $\vecf{v} = \tp{(5, 2, -1)}$.
Since $\aug{\vx} = \tp{(1, x_1, x_2)}$ by @def-augmented-vector,

$$
\dprod{\vecf{v}}{\aug{\vx}} = 5 \cd 1 + 2 x_1 + (-1) x_2 = f(\vx).
$$

The first entry of $\vecf{v}$ is the [offset](#def-affine-offset) $5$,
and the other two are the numbers multiplying $x_1$ and $x_2$.

:::
